title: Base MVC/Razor Products app / views / layouts / partials / view components
meaning: The base MVC example is a small Products application used to demonstrate controller-to-view flow.
Views are Razor files under Views/<Controller>/<Action>.cshtml or shared locations such as Views/Shared.
_Layout, _ViewStart and _ViewImports define common layout and Razor imports/tag-helper availability.
Strongly typed views receive a model or view model from the controller.
Partials and view components split reusable UI pieces out of larger views.
boundary_notes: R02 covers ViewData/ViewBag/TempData and validation flow.
R03/R04 cover tag helpers, cache helper, display templates and component/helper details.
